articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that merges the previous o-series reasoning models with the GPT line. The model demonstrates step-change improvements on PhD-level science benchmarks and complex agentic coding tasks, though researchers note diminishing returns on certain narrow evaluations.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Benchmarks in Agentic Software Engineering
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra with state-of-the-art performance on SWE-Bench Verified and real-world agentic workflow benchmarks, narrowing the gap with OpenAI's latest models. The model introduces a novel mixture-of-experts architecture refinement that significantly reduces inference cost while maintaining top-tier accuracy on multi-step tool-use tasks.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 4 with Breakthrough Long-Context Fidelity
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude 4, emphasizing dramatically improved faithfulness over million-token context windows and reduced confabulation rates in enterprise retrieval-augmented generation workflows. The model also ships with enhanced tool use and a new constitutional AI training methodology that Anthropic claims yields more controllable and auditable outputs.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the start of paid commercial deployment of its Figure 02 humanoid robots at BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina, marking one of the first scaled humanoid deployments in automotive manufacturing. The robots handle parts transfer and inspection tasks autonomously for full shifts, with Figure reporting a 95% uptime rate during the pilot phase.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster Response Navigation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics showcased its electric Atlas robot autonomously navigating collapsed building environments in a DARPA-affiliated exercise, using on-board LiDAR and a vision-language model for real-time scene understanding and path planning. The demonstration highlighted significant progress in unstructured terrain locomotion and human-robot communication via natural language commands in the field.

articles.title: Tesla Begins Limited Unsupervised FSD Rollout in Austin and the Bay Area
articles.summary: Tesla activated its first unsupervised Full Self-Driving deployments for employee vehicles in Austin and parts of the San Francisco Bay Area, operating without a safety driver on pre-mapped routes. The rollout uses Tesla's end-to-end neural network vision stack on HW4 hardware and represents a critical regulatory milestone after months of negotiation with NHTSA and state DMVs.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production at Arizona Fab with 3nm Process for US Customers
articles.summary: TSMC's first Arizona fabrication facility has entered volume production on its N3E process node, producing chips for Apple and AMD and marking a landmark moment for US semiconductor reshoring efforts under the CHIPS Act. Yield rates are reported to be approaching parity with TSMC's Taiwan facilities, defying earlier skepticism about domestic manufacturing competitiveness.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Behemoth with 2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, its largest open-source model at over two trillion parameters using a massive mixture-of-experts architecture, under a permissive license for commercial use. Early community benchmarks show it rivaling proprietary frontier models on reasoning and coding tasks, intensifying the debate over the viability of open-weight models versus closed APIs.
